title: China AI supplier Zhongji Innolight slips in Hong Kong debut after $6.8 billion IPO
summary: Zhongji Innolight, a Chinese optical transceiver maker, saw its shares fall following its Hong Kong Stock Exchange debut after a $6.8 billion IPO. The decline reflects investor concerns about valuations or market conditions for Chinese tech companies.
content: Shares of Zhongji Innolight fell on Thursday after the Chinese optical transceiver maker made its trading debut on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

zh.title: 中国AI供应商中际创芯在68亿美元IPO后香港上市首日下跌
zh.summary: 中国光学收发器制造商中际创芯在完成68亿美元IPO后于香港证券交易所上市，随后股价下跌。此跌幅反映了投资者对中国科技公司估值和市场形势的担忧。

title: The once destroyed community that's now a global energy giant
summary: A US county devastated by a hurricane has transformed into the world's largest exporter of liquified natural gas, representing a dramatic economic recovery. The turnaround highlights the potential for disaster-struck regions to rebuild as global economic powerhouses.
content: A US county wiped out by a hurricane is now the world's largest exporter of liquified natural gas.

zh.title: 曾经被摧毁的社区如今成为全球能源巨头
zh.summary: 一个被飓风摧毁的美国县已转变成全球最大的液化天然气出口国，实现了戏剧性的经济复苏。这一转变展现了灾难地区可以重建成为全球经济强国的潜力。

title: Inside India newsletter: Meta's clout in the world's largest democracy is surging — inviting scrutiny
summary: Meta Platforms has significantly expanded its influence in India as Gen Z protesters increasingly use Instagram to mobilize against the Modi government. The growing clout is attracting regulatory scrutiny of the social media giant's power in the world's most populous democracy.
content: Meta Platforms has strengthened its influence on India as Gen Z protesters widely relied on Instagram to raise their concerns against the Modi government.

zh.title: 印度内幕通讯：Meta在全球最大民主国家的影响力激增，引发监管审查
zh.summary: 随着Z世代抗议者越来越多地利用Instagram动员反对莫迪政府，Meta Platforms已大幅扩展其在印度的影响力。这种日益增长的影响力正引发对该社交媒体巨头在世界最人口众多民主国家权力的监管审查。

title: Stock futures rise as Microsoft jumps after earnings; traders hope to recover from Fed Day sell-off: Live updates
summary: Stock futures rose as Microsoft surged following strong earnings, with investors attempting to recover losses from a Federal Reserve decision day sell-off. Megacap tech earnings and the Fed's decision to maintain steady rates dominated market sentiment.
content: Investors were digesting megacap tech earnings and the Federal Reserve's decision to hold rates steady.

zh.title: 微软强劲财报推动股指期货上升；交易员希望从美联储决议日抛售中反弹：实时更新
zh.summary: 微软在强劲财报后大幅上升，股指期货随之上升，投资者试图恢复美联储决议日抛售造成的损失。大型科技公司财报和美联储维持利率不变的决定主导了市场情绪。

title: U.S. resumes strikes against Iran, retaliating against surprise missile attack
summary: US forces resumed military strikes against Iran on Wednesday in retaliation for a surprise missile attack, escalating tensions after a brief pause. The action signals a return to direct military confrontation between the two nations.
content: The U.S. forces began launching strikes against Iran Wednesday stateside, plunging the two sides back into open conflict after a days-long pause.

zh.title: 美国对伊朗恢复军事打击，报复突然导弹攻击
zh.summary: 美国军队周三对伊朗恢复军事打击，以报复突然的导弹攻击，在短暂暂停后升级了紧张局势。这一行动标志着两国之间直接军事对抗的回归。

title: Microsoft jumps 8% as it boosts capital spending plans, citing demand
summary: Microsoft's stock surged 8% after the company increased its capital spending plans to meet strong AI infrastructure demand. The company also forecast positive free cash flow for the new fiscal year following accounting changes for data centers and office buildings.
content: Microsoft sees positive free cash flow for the new fiscal year as it changes accounting for data centers and office buildings.

zh.title: 微软股价上涨8%，因其提高资本支出计划以应对需求
zh.summary: 微软因增加资本支出计划以满足强劲的人工智能基础设施需求，其股价飙升8%。公司还预测，由于数据中心和办公楼的会计方法变更，新财年将实现正自由现金流。

title: Why SoFi’s stock drops, even after its earnings beat expectations
summary: SoFi's stock declined despite beating earnings expectations, as investors were disappointed by the neobank's cautious forward guidance. The restraint in guidance overshadowed stronger-than-expected quarterly results.
content: Investors were disappointed by the neobank’s restrained guidance.

zh.title: SoFi股票为何下跌——尽管盈利超预期
zh.summary: SoFi股票下跌，尽管其盈利超过预期，但投资者对该新银行谨慎的前景指引感到失望。指引的保守态度掩盖了季度业绩超预期的表现。

title: Analysis: Fed Chairman Warsh's credibility in question after leaving interest rates unchanged
summary: Fed Chairman Warsh's credibility faces scrutiny following the Fed's decision to hold interest rates steady while long-term Treasury yields jumped. Investors question whether the Fed will take sufficiently aggressive action to address inflation.
content: The Fed held interest rates steady, but long-term Treasury yields jumped. Investors are questioning whether he will act forcefully enough on inflation.

zh.title: 分析：美联储主席沃什在维持利率不变后面临信誉危机
zh.summary: 美联储主席沃什的信誉因美联储决定维持利率不变而受到审视，此时长期国债收益率大幅上升。投资者质疑美联储是否会采取足够激进的行动来应对通胀。

title: Zuckerberg lays out Meta's AI capacity dilemma: What to sell vs. what to keep
summary: Mark Zuckerberg addressed investor concerns about Meta's massive AI spending by explaining the company faces a strategic trade-off between monetizing AI capabilities and retaining them for competitive advantage. The dilemma underscores investor anxiety about returns on the company's substantial capital expenditures.
content: For investors anxious to hear more about Meta's plans to make money from its big AI spending, Mark Zuckerberg said there's a trade-off.

zh.title: 扎克伯格阐述Meta的AI容量困境：出售还是保留
zh.summary: 马克·扎克伯格通过解释公司在将AI能力商业化和为竞争优势保留AI能力之间面临的战略权衡，来应对投资者对Meta巨大AI支出的担忧。这个困境突显了投资者对公司大额资本支出回报的担忧。

title: Microsoft aces earnings call, while Meta frustration grows: 'Do we just need to be a bit more patient?'
summary: Microsoft delivered strong earnings results while Meta faced investor frustration over returns on massive capital expenditures in AI infrastructure. Wall Street's impatience reflects uncertainty about the timeline and profitability of AI investments.
content: Wall Street wants bang for its buck after massive capital expenditures

zh.title: 微软财报表现出众，Meta投资者失望加剧："我们是否只需要再耐心一点？"
zh.summary: 微软公布了强劲的财务业绩，而Meta因在AI基础设施上投入巨额资本支出的回报而面临投资者不满。华尔街的不耐烦反映了人们对AI投资时间表和盈利能力的不确定性。

title: We're raising our price target on Starbucks after a home-run quarter
summary: Starbucks' stock surged in extended trading after a strong quarterly performance, with analysts raising price targets reflecting CEO Brian Niccol's successful turnaround strategy. The improvements in operational performance boosted investor confidence.
content: Shares jumped in extended trading Thursday as CEO Brian Niccol's turnaround gathers momentum.

zh.title: 星巴克创纪录季度后，我们上调了目标价
zh.summary: 在强劲季度业绩之后，星巴克股票在盘后交易中大幅上涨，分析师上调了目标价以反映首席执行官Brian Niccol的成功扭转战略。运营表现的改善提升了投资者信心。

title: Burnham says nuclear sub investment will protect UK and boost jobs
summary: UK Prime Minister Burnham highlighted the economic and security benefits of nuclear submarine investments ahead of a visit to Barrow-in-Furness. The government seeks to emphasize job creation and defense spending as drivers of local economic development.
content: Speaking ahead of a visit to Barrow-in-Furness, the PM seeks to stress the economic benefits of defence spending.

zh.title: Burnham表示核潜艇投资将保护英国并创造就业
zh.summary: 英国首相Burnham在访问巴罗因弗内斯之前强调了核潜艇投资的经济和安全效益。政府试图强调就业创造和国防支出是当地经济发展的驱动力。

title: Samsung Electronics second-quarter operating profit beats estimates on soaring AI chip demand
summary: Samsung Electronics reported second-quarter operating profit that exceeded analyst estimates, driven by surging demand for AI chips. The strong performance extends the company's record profitability run as AI infrastructure demand accelerates.
content: Samsung Electronics extended its record run with second-quarter operating profit topping analysts' estimates.

zh.title: 三星电子第二季度营业利润因AI芯片需求飙升而超预期
zh.summary: 三星电子报告称第二季度营业利润超过分析师预期，这得益于对AI芯片的激增需求。这一强劲表现延续了该公司盈利能力创纪录增长的态势，因为AI基础设施需求加速增长。

title: Trump considering AI controls after OpenAI hacking incidents
summary: The Trump administration is considering imposing AI regulatory controls following hacking incidents at OpenAI, marking a shift from its typically hands-off approach to technology regulation. The proposal suggests heightened national security concerns about AI systems and their vulnerabilities.
content: It marks a change of tone for his administration, which has taken a more hands-off approach to the technology.

zh.title: 特朗普在OpenAI黑客事件后考虑实施AI管制
zh.summary: 特朗普政府正在考虑在OpenAI遭黑客攻击事件后实施AI监管管制，这标志着其从通常对技术监管持不干涉态度的立场发生转变。该提议表明对AI系统及其漏洞的国家安全忧虑加剧。

title: Qualcomm’s stock falls as memory woes weigh on earnings
summary: Qualcomm's stock declined after the chip company missed earnings expectations, with memory-related challenges impacting financial results. The underperformance reflects broader headwinds in the semiconductor sector.
content: The chip company came up short on its bottom line.

zh.title: 高通股价下跌，存储问题拖累业绩
zh.summary: 高通股价在芯片公司未达到收益预期后下跌，存储相关的挑战影响了财务业绩。这种表现不佳反映了半导体行业面临的更广泛逆风。
